checks.name: Source gate PASS, source/acquisition/complete eligibility ledger pins and original tokenizer are mandatory

Original data_prepare source constants remain unchanged; no runtime monkeypatch
Original paths, old test corpus, sealed external records and all snapshot paths form one exact union; missing or extra files stop
Snapshot policy aliases require exact registered bytes and suffix plus unambiguous classification; archive member aliases preserve bound origins
Unknown historical formats and changed registered bytes stop instead of being skipped
All eligible candidates are indexed for history exclusion; all physical files and recovery notes remain in full ledger
History or new-new duplicates may still make the fixed quota BLOCKED; witness and full candidate records are retained
Output provenance binds train source while preserving128 input,64 scored positions,129 tokens and zero optimizer steps
Immutable acquisition/history freeze A must match and be ancestor of clean preparation freeze B; acquisition source bytes remain unchanged
Lossless physical/canonical gzip pins, exclusive writes, allocation and reserve gates preserve partial failure evidence
Exact isolated CLI exposes all three frozen bridge arguments and imports no numerical packages in development tests

limitations: This receipt accepts local synthetic development only. Actual source/history/model evidence must pass its own target gates.
The shared historical parser is reused, including declared conservative malformed Python/JSONL recovery; this is not reconstruction of missing source bytes.
Historical novelty covers retained registered project inputs and source text. Unrecorded private history and model pretraining overlap remain unknown.
The worker does not download or copy the train corpus. Its source file remains in source-v6.
No upstream code, scientific threshold, token position, model weight or earlier failed protocol is modified.
next_unique_instruction: After independent review and a separate preparation freeze B, run prepare_history_v6 once with the exact B/spec/gate hashes. Stop on BLOCKED/FAIL and preserve evidence; only a complete independent data audit may authorize dependent model execution.
